children: Gupta joins from HarperCollins Publishers India after more than 14 years in finance roles at Penguin Random House India
RP Sanjiv Goenka Group (RPSG) has appointed Madhur Gupta as Chief Financial Officer of its Media business, according to a professional update shared on LinkedIn.

Gupta joins RPSG from HarperCollins Publishers India, where he served as Chief Financial Officer and Operations Head from November 2023. Before that, he spent more than 14 years at Penguin Random House India, holding finance roles including Vice President-Finance, Financial Controller and General Manager-Finance between April 2009 and November 2023.
During his tenure at Penguin Random House India, Gupta was involved in post-merger integration following the merger of Penguin and Random House.
Earlier in his career, Gupta worked as Finance Manager at Silicon Graphics and Manager-Finance and Taxation at Surya Herbal.

Commenting on the appointment, Gupta posted on LinkedIn, “Stepping into this iconic group with its rich legacy and forward-looking vision in media and entertainment is a great honour. I'm looking forward to partnering with the leadership team and talented colleagues across the business to drive sustainable growth, unlock value, and shape the next chapter of our media journey.”

Gupta is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He also completed an Executive Programme in Leadership and Management, with a focus on Organisational Leadership, at the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta.
